method.model: chemical mass balance with fixed reference profiles (v2)
method.activation_transform: row-wise NNLS onto the fixed profiles
method.stage1: NNLS of CAMS PM2.5 on activations, within-site anomalies (site fixed effects)
method.stage2: NNLS of observed PM2.5 on [stage-1 PM2.5, 1]: obs = alpha*model + beta

traffic.label: Traffic & urban combustion
traffic.description: Nitrogen oxides (NO2 and freshly emitted NO) with some carbon monoxide: the signature of vehicle exhaust and other street-level fuel burning, including the secondary nitrate that forms from it.

industry.label: Industry, coal & power
industry.description: Sulphur dioxide with some NO2 and carbon monoxide: the signature of coal, oil, power plants and industry, including the secondary sulphate that forms from it.

burning.label: Fires & biomass burning
burning.description: Carbon monoxide and formaldehyde with little NO2: smoke from crop, forest and savanna fires and household wood and dung burning.

dust.label: Desert dust
dust.description: Mineral dust blown from deserts and dry land such as the Sahara, Arabia and the Thar, often carried hundreds of kilometres.

secondary.label: Photochemical & secondary
secondary.description: Ozone with some formaldehyde: chemically aged air in which sunlight turns gases into secondary organic and inorganic particles, a regional haze found almost everywhere.

marine.label: Sea salt (marine)
marine.description: Sea-salt spray from breaking ocean waves, carried inland by onshore winds at coastal sites.

background.label: Regional background & other
background.description: PM2.5 that none of the tracer signatures explains: long-range background, local sources the global CAMS model does not resolve, and the part of the measured level that the tracers cannot account for.
